  "hypothesis": "Predicted that different combinations of augmented feedback, external focus, and monetary reward would influence countermovement jump performance.",
  "design": "within, six conditions: no feedback (NE), augmented feedback (aF), monetary reward (RE), aF + external focus (EF), aF + RE, and aF + EF + RE.",
  "manipulation_or_predictor": "The experimental conditions varied by the presence or absence of augmented feedback (visual display of jump height), external focus (instruction to pull a cord), and monetary reward (payment based on jump height).",
  "outcome_measure": "Maximal jump height measured via motion capture system.",
  "population_and_setting": "18 athletic adults without neurological or orthopedic injuries, tested in a laboratory setting.",
  "sample_size_total": 18,
  "recruitment_and_incentive": "Participants were recruited and informed of the study purpose; monetary reward was provided based on performance in specific conditions.",
  "analysis_plan": "One-way repeated measures ANOVA followed by Bonferroni-corrected Student's t-tests for post hoc pairwise comparisons.",
  "preregistered_or_confirmatory": "not stated",
  "other_methods_notes": "Participants performed 16 series of six maximal countermovement jumps. The order of conditions was randomized, except for the no-feedback condition which was distributed throughout the experiment. Fatigue was controlled by comparing baseline and final no-feedback series."
